AI vs physician

Dermoscopy-Based AI Risk Scoring Enhanced Experienced Dermatologists' Decision-Making: a Large Retrospective Reader Study

This week’s result: AI helped improve.

The biggest gain was in catching melanoma, even among experienced dermatologists, which makes this a useful example of measuring AI by how it changes clinicians' decisions rather than by the model's accuracy alone. // THE ONE THING
Dermoscopy-Based AI Risk Scoring Enhanced Experienced Dermatologists' Decision-Making: a Large Retrospective Reader Study
The biggest gain was in catching melanoma, even among experienced dermatologists, which makes this a useful example of measuring AI by how it changes clinicians' decisions rather than by the model's accuracy alone. Learners should note that a before-and-after reader study on images does not show how the tool would perform with real patients.
https://www.dpcj.org/index.php/dpc/article/view/6981

// AI VS PHYSICIAN
This week: Physicians outperformed AI
Diagnostic Accuracy of Large Language Models for Pediatric Chest Radiograph: Comparison With Pediatricians and Radiologists
Trainees who upload images to general-purpose chatbots should know that these tools gave only fair screening and fell off sharply on specific diagnoses. Pediatricians did better on most measures in this study.
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43033194
